result.output:
{"actor":"github-actions[bot]","check_suite_id":122459637906,"conclusion":"failure","event":"pull_request","path":".github/workflows/ci.yml","status":"completed","triggering_actor":"github-actions[bot]"}
          > **Note:** The post is written directly into \`posts/\`, so merging this PR
          > publishes and deploys it to the site. Close the PR without merging to discard.

          *Generated via GitHub Actions*
          EOF
          )

          gh pr create \
            --title "📝 Blog Draft: $DRAFT_TITLE" \
            --body "$PR_BODY" \
            --label "blog-draft" \
            --base master

          # Pushes and PRs made with GITHUB_TOKEN start no workflow runs, so on
          # its own this PR would get no CI at all: no content-schema/dedupe
          # tests, no build, no spell check. workflow_dispatch is the one event
          # GITHUB_TOKEN may still trigger, and the runs report their checks
          # on the branch's head commit, which is the PR's.
          # Retry transient API errors, and attempt every dispatch before failing
          # so one bad response can't leave the PR without its other checks.
          dispatch() {
            local attempt
            for attempt in 1 2 3 4; do
              gh workflow run "$@" && return 0
              echo "::warning::gh workflow run $1 failed (attempt $attempt of 4)"
              [ "$attempt" -lt 4 ] && sleep $((attempt * 15))
            done
            echo "::error::Could not dispatch $1; run it manually on $BRANCH"
            return 1
          }
          dispatch_failed=0
          for wf in ci.yml typos.yml; do
            dispatch "$wf" --ref "$BRANCH" || dispatch_failed=1
          done
          # base=master scopes the secret scan to this PR's commits; without it
          # a dispatched gitleaks run scans every branch's full history.
          dispatch gitleaks.yml --ref "$BRANCH" -f base=master || dispatch_failed=1
          exit "$dispatch_failed"

assert old in s; s=s.replace(old,new,1); open(p,'w').write(s)
